Lena (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: security questions kept coming in. Starting a short thread for leadership + docs owners to confirm next steps.
Daphne (Head of Security): Thanks — I'll summarize and assign owners.
Marco (Solutions): Customer asked whether Hosted will allow BYOK and what the retention for audit logs is by default.
Daphne (Head of Security): BYOK: planned roadmap — AWS KMS + GCP KMS support for Hosted planned mid-Q4; Azure KV later. Private deployments already support customer-managed keys/HSM. Audit logs: control-plane default retention is 90 days; Extended retention (365 days) available as an enterprise add-on.
Isha (NetEng): Networking: recommendation is PrivateLink for hosted connectivity. We'll publish required outbound rules and per-region endpoints.
Nora (Compliance): SOC2: readiness assessment nearly complete. Plan to pursue Type II for Hosted this fiscal year; Dedicated customers will receive attestation guidance but Dedicated/Private differ since infra is customer-managed. We will publish the auditor once contracted.
Marco (Solutions): Can we get a single-page "security at Redwood" for the Console that covers SOC2, KMS, VPC connectivity, and log exports? Customers keep asking for a short comparison.
Daphne (Head of Security): Action: Daphne + Nora + Marco will produce a customer one-pager and a Console FAQ. ETA: next Wednesday.
ops-bot: Doc draft created: /docs/security/security-onepager-draft.md (internal). Link: https://intranet.redwood/docs/security/security-onepager-draft
Lena (CEO): Please also add a short FAQs section in the Console sign-up flow about Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private security tradeoffs. Daphne + Product to coordinate.
Daphne (Head of Security): Acknowledged. If anyone has high-priority customer asks (contracts/early BYOK), DM me. :lock:
